question: Which Indian author has chronicled the life in the Kumaon hills in the book ‘Things to leave behind’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Namita Gokhale.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Namita Gokhale wrote the popular book ‘ Things to leave behind’.
 
• She won the Sushila Devi Literature award for this novel in the year 2019.
 
• She has written several books like, ‘In search of Sita: Revisiting mythology’, ‘Paro: Dreams of passion’ etc.
